subject.title: Allow owners and authors to delete messages

question: Should workspace-owner deletion include direct-message content belonging to conversations the owner is not part of, or be limited to workspace channels and their threads?
rationale: The changed store guard is workspace-wide, so the merge selects a privacy and moderation policy that automated tests cannot decide.

options.title: Limit owners to channels
options.body: Allow owners to delete channel messages and thread replies while keeping direct-message deletion author- or participant-scoped.

options.title: Allow all workspace messages
options.body: Approve owner deletion in DMs too, with explicit documentation, audit expectations, and focused permission proof.

recommendation.title: Limit owners to channels
recommendation.body: Allow owners to delete channel messages and thread replies while keeping direct-message deletion author- or participant-scoped.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available adjacent current-main owner and the choice affects repository-wide moderation policy.
